items.title: Gordon Lorraine — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Frank Wolff, his cohort. We met. We talked. We got married. [LAUGHS] Not then and there, but... There were interludes.

ctx.x: He was very beautiful and played very well. Anyway, I sat on this little side banquette, and Ralph’s sitting next to me, and he finally said, “Right across the room there, that’s Alfred Lion.” I said, “Really?” My eyes popped up. He said, “I’ll introduce you.” So he did take me over, and I met Alfred Lion for the first time in my life, sitting there, I assume, with Frank, who I did not know at the time—Frank Wolff, his cohort. We met. We talked. We got married. [LAUGHS] Not then and there, but... There were…
Then that launched your actual hands-on involvement with creating jazz records. Is that a fair way to portray that...
